<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
I will create a comprehensive data-model.md file.

The document will present decisions as proposed drafts marked for confirmation. It will include an ER diagram, persistent entities, enumerations, and relationships.

The remaining sections will cover RAG and vector models, API DTOs, ticket metadata objects, embedded types, data flows, Liquibase table definitions, search and filter persistence, domain validation rules, open questions with proposed resolutions, and acceptance criteria.

A revision history section will be added.

Ticket IDs will use a human-readable `TKT-{n}` format generated by a PostgreSQL sequence starting at 1001. Priority will be a closed enum with LOW, MEDIUM, and HIGH values. Category will be a closed enum with PAYMENTS, SHIPMENT, BILLING, LOGIN, and OTHER options. Resolution notes will be stored in a dedicated nullable TEXT column on the tickets table.

Initial ticket status will default to OPEN. Search will match title and description using case-insensitive ILIKE. Required creation fields are title and priority, with description defaulting to empty string and assignee optional. Comments will use UUID identifiers, a foreign key to the ticket, and a text body. Author information is omitted because it is absent from the PDF. Status transitions will not be tracked in a separate audit table; the updated_at timestamp on the ticket entity will suffice.

The vector store will use a `ticket_vector_chunk` table with UUID primary key, ticket_id foreign key, chunk_index, content TEXT, embedding vector(d), and metadata JSONB. In-memory domain types such as KnowledgeDocument, ChunkDescriptor, RagChunkMetadata, and AskContext will be documented alongside the persisted schema. An `AuditTimestamps` embeddable will provide createdAt and updatedAt fields on the Ticket entity.

RagMetadata will be modeled as a plain record rather than a JPA embeddable for vector JSON storage.
</details></think>

Created [`spec/data-model.md`](spec/data-model.md) as a draft data-model spec aligned with the assessment, [`spec/requirements.md`](spec/requirements.md), and [`spec/architecture.md`](spec/architecture.md).

### What it covers

| Area | Contents |
|------|----------|
| **Relational entities** | `ticket`, `ticket_comment` — columns, types, indexes, FKs, cascade rules |
| **Vector / RAG persistence** | `ticket_vector_chunk` (PgVector), re-ingest delete-and-replace strategy |
| **Relationships** | 1:N ticket→comments, 1:N ticket→chunks; ER and association notes |
| **Enums** | `TicketStatus` (**PDF**), proposed `TicketPriority` / `TicketCategory` |
| **Logical RAG types** | `KnowledgeDocument`, `TextChunk`, `RetrievedChunk`, assembly template |
| **DTOs** | Create/update/detail/comment request and response records (camelCase, PATCH partial) |
| **RAG metadata** | `RagChunkMetadata` — PDF keys plus technical keys; snapshot-on-ingest flow |
| **Embedded models** | Optional `AuditTimestamps`; JSONB metadata (not flattened) |
| **Data flows** | Create, update, comment, status transition, ask (read-only), restart recovery |
| **Liquibase** | Changelog order, sequence `TKT-{n}` from 1001, DDL sketches |
| **Search** | **Proposed** DEC-08: `q` on `title` + `description` only |

### Proposed decisions (need your confirmation per §10)

These are marked **draft** in the spec until you agree:

- **DEC-04:** Public id `TKT-{n}` via `ticket_number_seq` (starts at 1001)
- **DEC-03:** Optional category enum (`PAYMENTS`, `SHIPMENT`, `BILLING`, `LOGIN`, `OTHER`)
- **DEC-05:** `resolution_notes` column on `ticket`
- **DEC-07:** Initial status `OPEN` (server-side only on create)
- **DEC-08:** Keyword search on title + description (not comments)
- **DEC-13:** Create requires `title`; other fields optional with defaults (`MEDIUM` priority, empty description)

If you want different choices (e.g. UUID ids, search including comments, or required assignee on create), say which DECs to change and I’ll update the spec and can sync `requirements.md` §10.2.

**Note:** [`requirements.md`](spec/requirements.md) still lists `data-model.md` as missing in its table — I can update that row once you’re happy with this draft.

- A composite index on status and created_at for filtered list sorting

Keyword search on title and description will use pg_trgm GIN indexes. These are optional and recommended for scale. B-tree indexes will not support ILIKE patterns. A GIN index on the JSONB metadata column will also be included.

The comment table needs an index on ticket_id for foreign-key joins and cascade operations. The vector table requires a unique index on ticket_id and chunk_index, plus a separate index on ticket_id to support re-ingestion deletes.

The vector table will use an HNSW index on the embedding column. This index is documented in the data model with its type and purpose, while distance metrics remain in the ingestion guide. Partial indexes were considered but rejected as overkill. The new section will present a table listing index names, tables, types, columns, purposes, and query patterns. DDL sections will be updated with CREATE INDEX statements.

The index catalog will be inserted as subsection 14.5 under the Liquibase section. A companion subsection 14.6 will hold the full SQL changesets. The existing sections 15 through 19 will be renumbered to 16 through 20 to accommodate the new material. A cross-reference from section 6.1 will be added. The documentation.md reviewer map will be updated to reflect the new section numbers.
</details></think>

```bash
python3 << 'PY'
import re
from pathlib import Path

SPECS = ("requirements", "architecture", "data-model")
ROOT = Path("/Users/vishnuaggarwal/Documents/projects/practice/ticket-management")

def linkify(text: str) -> str:
    for name in SPECS:
        path = f"spec/{name}.md"
        url = f"../spec/{name}.md"
        full_link = f"[`{path}`]({url})"
        # Already linked forms — skip
        if full_link in text:
            pass
        # Backtick path not already start of a markdown link
        text = re.sub(
            rf"(?<!\])\[`{re.escape(path)}`\]\({re.escape(url)}\)",
            full_link,
            text,
        )
        # `spec/foo.md` -> link (not if already part of [`](...))
        def repl_backtick(m):
            return full_link
        text = re.sub(
            rf"`{re.escape(path)}`(?!`\]\({re.escape(url)}\))",
            repl_backtick,
            text,
        )
        # **spec/foo.md** -> **link**
        text = re.sub(
            rf"\*\*`{re.escape(path)}`\*\*",
            f"**{full_link}**",
            text,
        )
        # Bare spec/foo.md (not inside existing markdown URL)
        text = re.sub(
            rf"(?<!\]\(){re.escape(path)}(?!\))",
            full_link,
            text,
        )
    # Fix accidental double links from bare pass after backtick pass
    for name in SPECS:
        path = f"spec/{name}.md"
        url = f"../spec/{name}.md"
        full_link = f"[`{path}`]({url})"
        double = f"[{full_link}]({url})"
        while double in text:
            text = text.replace(double, full_link)
        nested = f"[`[`{path}`]({url})`]({url})"
        while nested in text:
            text = text.replace(nested, full_link)
    return text

changed = []
for sub in ("rules", "commands"):
    for p in sorted((ROOT / sub).glob("*.md")):
        orig = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        new = linkify(orig)
        if new != orig:
            p.write_text(new, encoding="utf-8")
            changed.append(str(p.relative_to(ROOT)))

print("Updated:", len(changed), "files")
for c in changed:
    print(" ", c)
PY
```
